installed_package.name: orthofinder
installed_package.scope: Installed metadata and source identity, not universal immutable attestation of historical executable consumption. The existing runtime receipt explicitly leaves historical execution unproven.

installed_source_evidence.read_sections: post_hogs_processing, update_ogs and MCL.CreateOGs: root-HOG-derived groups plus unassigned singletons are written to the standard Orthogroups result base.
update_output_files: convert the first root HOG table, call post_hogs_processing, then update alignments/trees.
Standard inference path around lines580-690: InferOrthologs, update_output_files under fix_files, another InferOrthologs pass; default legacy cleanup removes the first N0 table and Legacy directory.
Options defaults fix_files=True, qStopAfterGroups=False; --no-fix-files disables the rewrite and -rmlg disables legacy removal.

three_kingdoms_selected_output_binding: Independently restored the native official group identifiers through the bijective OrthoFinder sanitization map and proved exact partition equality with the retained selected Three Kingdoms orthogroups.txt. The 5146 colon-containing identifiers were already restored by the original benchmark converter; no new gene filtering, membership change or rescore.

annotation_refinement.OrthoBench_full: Official OrthoFinder3.1.5 post-phylogenetic Orthogroups.txt partition, generated from the first root-HOG pass with unassigned singleton padding; not the initial MCL checkpoint and not identical to the later retained N0.ids.tsv partition.
annotation_refinement.QfO_full: Retain native phylogenetically inferred pair semantics and the original assessed pair table. The group-stage contrast does not replace these pairs with a root-group clique.
annotation_refinement.ThreeKingdoms_full: Reference-gene co-membership of the official post-phylogenetic partition with original FASTA IDs restored, including within-species reference pairs. Not a pairwise phylogenetic-orthology endpoint.
annotation_refinement.sequence_only: Retain the same-run pre-phylogenetic MCL checkpoint diagnostic and its original gene mapping/projection. No separately timed sequence-only inference is established.
annotation_refinement.historical_wording: The retained OrthoBench registry's shorthand final root HOGs is imprecise for the two-pass v3 output. This supplemental annotation refines that description without modifying the immutable registry/table or substituting a later debug partition.

independent_readback: Reparsed official groups directly and root HOGs through a separate DictReader traversal, checked unique complete gene universes, reproduced every official-versus-later membership count and restored-ID count, and proved every later padded HOG lies within one official group. Rechecked the selected Three Kingdoms output equality, all five reader/helper Git blobs, original package-source pins, installed metadata, current score-table pins and 78 unique postflight records. MCL parsing shares the existing tested converter and is not claimed as an independently implemented MCL parser.
retained_log_observations: OrthoBench run.log reports OrthoFinder3.1.5 and both Converting MSA/Trees and Done updating MSA/Trees on 2026-07-15.
Three Kingdoms run.log reports OrthoFinder3.1.5 and both update-stage messages on 2026-09-07.
exploratory_setup_observations: An initial expectation of exact equality between official groups and the later N0.ids table failed. Installed source inspection identified the intervening second inference pass; the audit now distinguishes stages and verifies the observed refinement relation rather than weakening any scientific accuracy gate.

An initial raw Three Kingdoms identifier comparison failed on colon sanitization. Applied the already established bijective restoration rule and independently proved the selected output's unchanged membership.

resources.scope: Read-only diagnostic only; not OrthoFinder inference or a tool speed comparison. GNU-time maximum process RSS, not simultaneous process-tree/cgroup peak. Independent readback excluded.

limits: The first root HOG table/Legacy outputs were removed by default cleanup; exact historical first-pass input reconstruction is not claimed.
Installed source, retained logs and consistent memberships do not independently attest immutable historical execution or every input-consumption path.
Different intermediate partitions are not evidence of different biological accuracy. No new score was calculated or selected after inspecting these stage differences.
All existing benchmarks remain development-exposed. This audit does not supply independent confirmation or universal superiority.
